enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with the blanket over the body. Turn over from one side to the other. Remain in bed asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Push the blanket aside. Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Rinse face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back. Turn on the shower. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Apply soap. Rub the body. Rinse off the soap. Turn off the shower. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Hang the towel. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast while listening to the news about the public transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Put the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Pick up the bread. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate and a mug. Close the cabinet. Crack the eggs into a bowl. Stir the eggs with a fork. Pour the eggs into the pan. Turn on the induction cooker. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Add a tea bag. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the eggs and toast. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Press the phone screen on. Open the news app. Read the news about the public transport strike. Put the phone down on the table. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone messages, confirming remote work arrangements because of the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt and trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pick up the phone from the bed. Press the phone screen on. Open the messaging app. Read the messages from the colleagues. Tap the reply box. Type a message confirming remote work. Press send. Put the phone down on the desk. Pull the chair out from the desk. Sit down on the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workstation at the desk, reviewing patient notes and work emails on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen to load. Press the monitor power button. Turn on the desk lamp. Adjust the lamp head. Open the email application. Scroll through the inbox. Click on the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply. Press send. Open the patient notes folder. Open the first patient file. Scroll through the notes. Read the notes. Close the file. Open the second patient file. Scroll through the notes. Read the notes. Close the file. Adjust the chair height. Adjust the chair backrest. Place both hands on the keyboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely: conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient care documentation on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open the video call application. Click on the first patient name. Start the video call. Put on the headset. Speak to the patient about symptoms. Write notes in the document with the keyboard. Ask the patient questions. End the call. Click the next patient name. Start the video call. Speak to the patient. Type notes. End the call. Pick up the phone. Check the messages. Put the phone down. Open the patient record file. Update the medication list. Type the care plan into the document. Save the file. Open the next patient record. Update the appointment date. Save the file. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the door. Walk back to the desk. Sit down on the chair. Click on the next patient name. Start the video call. Speak to the patient. Type notes. End the call.

Stand up from the chair. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the salad and the leftovers box. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the microwave door. Put the leftovers box into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave start button. Wait for the microwave to beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the leftovers box. Close the microwave door. Put the food onto a plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the lunch. Pick up the mug. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, watching TV and resting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Put the remote down on the sofa. Close eyes briefly. Open eyes. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work: reviewing patient records and coordinating care calls on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the computer keyboard space bar to wake the screen. Open the patient records folder. Open the first patient record. Scroll through the record. Read the record. Type the update into the record. Save the file. Close the file. Pick up the phone. Press the phone screen on. Dial the care coordinator. Speak on the phone about the patient schedule. End the call. Put the phone down. Open the next patient record. Read the record. Type the update. Save the file. Open the email application. Read the new email. Click reply. Type a reply about the care plan. Press send. Open the video call application. Click on the patient name. Start the video call. Speak to the patient. Type notes. End the call. Adjust the desk lamp. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the door. Walk back. Sit down on the chair. Open the next patient record. Read the record. Type the update. Save the file. Close the computer applications.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up and changing out of work clothes after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Rinse face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Take off the work shirt. Take off the work trousers. Put on a t-shirt. Put on casual trousers. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Put the remote down on the sofa. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Look at the TV screen.

Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the meat. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the meat into the pan. Stir the meat with a spatula. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir the vegetables. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food onto a plate. Pick up the plate. Carry it to the table. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner. Pick up the mug. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze soap onto the sponge. Pick up the plate. Scrub the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the water. Place the plate in the drying rack. Pick up the fork. Scrub the fork. Rinse the fork. Place the fork in the drying rack. Pick up the pan. Scrub the pan. Rinse the pan. Place the pan in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Put the cloth down. Wipe the table with the cloth. Put the leftovers box into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time: watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the sofa. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the computer from the table. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Open the browser. Scroll through the web pages. Click a video link. Watch the video. Type a search term. Press the enter key. Scroll through the results. Close the browser. Close the laptop lid. Put the computer down on the table. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the sofa. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Wait for the water to warm. Turn on the shower. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Apply soap. Rub the body. Rinse off the soap. Wash the hair with shampoo. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Hang the towel. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, watching TV and reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the TV remote from the desk. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the bed. Lean back against the headboard. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone from the bed. Press the phone screen on. Open the reading app. Scroll through the article. Read the article. Scroll down the page. Put the phone down on the bed. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone again. Open the messaging app. Read the messages. Put the phone down. Press the TV power button on the remote. Put the remote down on the nightstand. Turn off the bedroom light. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.
Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with the blanket over the body. Turn over from one side to the other. Remain in bed asleep.
